remarks: Welcome to the heart of South Norwalk! This charming studio offers the perfect blend of historic charm and modern convenience. Located just steps from SoNo's vibrant restaurant scene, waterfront attractions, and only a 10-minute walk to both The SoNo Collection mall and the train station has everything you need right at your doorstep.  Inside, you'll find southwest-facing windows and a private balcony that fill the space with natural light. With hardwood floors, and generous closet space throughout and equipped with a New Central AC system. The remodeled bathroom features a modern walk-in shower. The in-unit washer and dryer provide everyday convenience, and the kitchen is fully equipped with a dishwasher, stove, and refrigerator, ready for all your cooking needs.
